wx.uv-advice.low: No protection needed for most people.
wx.uv-advice.moderate: Shade around midday, a hat and sunscreen if outdoors for long.
wx.uv-advice.high: Cover up, sunscreen, and shade between 11am and 3pm.
wx.uv-advice.very-high: Avoid the midday sun. Shirt, hat, sunglasses and sunscreen.
wx.uv-advice.extreme: Stay out of the sun where you can. Full protection outdoors.
wx.heat-advice.low: Normal activity, with water and rest as usual.
wx.heat-advice.moderate: Drink more often and take breaks from strenuous activity outdoors.
wx.heat-advice.high: Cut back strenuous outdoor activity. Rest in the shade and drink water regularly.
